{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
duplicate_patients = df['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)
duplicate_count = duplicate_patients.sum()

duplicates_info = df[duplicate_patients]

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
missing_baseline = (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()

print(f"Total rows: {len(df)}")
print(f"Duplicate patient_id count: {duplicate_count}")
print(f"Rows with biomarker_baseline = -999: {missing_baseline}")

# Show sample of duplicates and missing data
print("\nSample of duplicate patient_ids:")
print(duplicates_info[['patient_id', 'sample_seq', 'biomarker_baseline']].head(10))

print("\nSample of -999 in biomarker_baseline:")
print(df[df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999][['patient_id', 'sample_seq', 'biomarker_baseline']].head(5))"}
